title: Capacity Power
texts:
The goal of this workout is to increase power endurance on medium to long length sustained routes. 

Find a collection of routes or circuits 1-2 grades below your on-sight where the climbing is sustained in style.  Climb your chosen route or circuit once and take 1 minute rest. 

Repeat this same route once more so that you've done two reps on the route/circuit in total. After set one you should feel moderately pumped but by sets 3-5 you should aim to be extremely pumped and possibly falling off the 2nd rep of each set. 

Ideally you should do this session on 5 different routes each at roughly the same grade to create movement variety.
